text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! The qi from the north-northeast is
growing?
Its strength is gradually
returning.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It makes sense! The expectations of the
people in
Tomakomai are rising. They're
rallying behind
Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with this much encouragement,
Tarumae will
surely compete in the Teio
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before the mentioned race,
Copano
Rickey and I are reviewing the
list of entrants.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae's name... it's not there. Why?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Her qi had recovered. The only thing left
was for
her to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taken aback as well. Quite a bit of
time has
passed since her defeat in
Dubai. She should have
recovered by
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Teio Sho is the grand finale of the
spring dirt
races. I was wholly convinced
that she'd run...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm going to go and talk to
Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Something is wrong! I've tried to avoid
talking
about the race, but if I just ask
her directly, then
I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's best to consider what Hokko
Tarumae might
be going through before
approaching her
directly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we think about what she's said and
done up to
now...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I did it... I actually did it! I got my first
trophy for
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering what I needed to do to
put
Tomakomai on the map, and I
figured the only
way was to make waves
on the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Imagine—if I win, everyone will know

Tomakomai's name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae has been consistent in
saying
that her victories are for
Tomakomai's benefit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, if she loses...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Guilty?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her devastating loss in Dubai, she
could be
blaming herself, thinking she's
disgraced the
honor of her hometown.
choice_data_list: Yeah, saying they can't face everyone back home.
Yeah, saying you couldn't face everyone back home.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae... Knowing her, I think you
might be
right. But still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
She mustn't close off the window to her
heart. If
she does, no breeze will reach
it, and that is the
worst thing she can do
feng shui-wise.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, trying to force it
open will
only make matters worse...
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right. If I go to meet her
right now,
it'd have the opposite effect.
choice_data_list: Let's channel our supportive spirit... during the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, on the day of the race...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute, let's do our best! ☆ Our fortunes
are
aligned today! So...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this race a million times
better than
the last one!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do it, Rickey. I just hope...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I really hope that Tarumae is watching
our race
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, Wonder Acute appears to

understand Hokko Tarumae's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fierce vortex intensifies between the
two. Will
their harmonious flames be
able to reach Hokko
Tarumae?
